stories.title: IIHF bars Belarus from WJC, men’s worlds; exploring ways to meet CAS ruling on Russia
stories.summary: The IIHF's council said its disciplinary board confirmed that there was not a legal basis to order reintegration at this time.

stories.title: Alberta’s hospital triage program now in operation: Danielle Smith
stories.summary: Alberta's government announced in January its plans for a program in which physicians would help triage patients following Prashant Sreekumar's high-profile death.

stories.title: Gauthier extends goal streak as Ducks top Flames
stories.summary: The scoring rampage continues for Cutter Gauthier.

stories.title: Gauthier scores winner as Ducks top Flames 5-3
stories.summary: Cutter Gauthier extended his goal streak to five games with the game-winner on Friday night as the Anaheim Ducks came back for a 5-3 victory over the Calgary Flames.

stories.title: Bail granted for former junior hockey exec accused of sex crimes against players
stories.summary: Tyler King, 39, is facing charges of luring, sexual exploitation and making child pornography. He was granted bail by an Alberta court Friday.

stories.title: ‘Manifesting millions’ pays off for winners of record $90M Lotto Max jackpot
stories.summary: A group of four friends were "manifesting millions" in a group chat when they decided to buy a lottery ticket. That manifestation came to fruition when they won $90 million.

stories.title: West final a showdown of well-rounded teams
stories.summary: Two franchises that haven't been in a Grey Cup game for more than 11 years will battle it out Saturday in the West Division final for the right to finally get back to the CFL championship game.

stories.title: Gretzky backs Carney’s Russian world junior ban
stories.summary: Wayne Gretzky played a big part in one of his country's crowning moments on the international sporting stage.

stories.title: Parents charged after baby dies of malnutrition, dehydration: Edmonton police
stories.summary: The parents of an Edmonton newborn who died last year have been charged, with police alleging the 25-day-old baby died from severe acute malnutrition and dehydration.

stories.title: Ducks keep torrid scoring pace in win over Oilers
stories.summary: The Anaheim Ducks are filling the net at a pace unseen before in franchise history.
